//: Default project — used by the editor and by `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm lint`.
Covers src + tests + vitest.config.ts and never emits, so no TS file in this repo can be
silently unchecked. Emitted output comes from tsconfig.build.json, which extends this one
`types` is pinned explicitly: automatic @types discovery is exactly what breaks in editors
for files outside `include`, producing 'Do you need to install type definitions for node?'
even though @types/node is installed as a devDependency.
